M4a baseline — live Supabase, 27 Aug 2026, BEFORE apply

WHAT EXISTS
  is_ops_admin()                exists
  policies gated on it          7
  functions gated on it         9
  _handover_owner falls back    YES - picks the first admin by sort order
  owner resolves to             lone@keywellness.co.bw  (because the key was
                                set by hand at the M4 apply; the FALLBACK is
                                still there and still picks france@)
  is_psychosocial_admin()       absent
  psychosocial_admins           absent

ADMINS (access - unchanged by this migration)
  france@keywealth.co.bw    <- MD, holds admin at his own request. NOT removed.
  france@prolearn.co.bw
  lone@keywellness.co.bw
  michelle@keywealth.co.bw
  tnmokgwetsi@gmail.com     <- testing and continuous build. NOT removed.

COUNTS THAT MUST NOT MOVE
  bookings 22 | organizations 3 | billing_handovers 0 | org_contracts 0
  support_actions 0

THE PREDICTION - written before applying. See the migration header.

  CHANGES NOTHING ABOUT WHO CAN DO WHAT, TODAY. is_ops_admin() is DEFINED as
  `select is_admin()`, so pointing its 16 call sites at is_admin() is a no-op
  in behaviour. The same people can do exactly the same things afterwards.

  CHANGES
    psychosocial_admins appears with TWO rows, Lone and Michelle.
    is_psychosocial_admin() appears, called by NOTHING - M3 wires it.
    is_ops_admin() disappears; 0 policies and 0 functions reference it.
    _handover_owner() loses the fallback: configured, or null.
    _billing_flags() gains a second kind, 'no_owner'.

  DOES NOT CHANGE
    The five counts above. France and Tshenolo keep every capability.
    tuesday_review_pack()'s shape: 'billing' entries gain a 'kind' field and
    may include a no-owner entry. Additive.

  IF IT IS WRONG
    A policy that matches nobody - an admin unable to write a contract. No
    data damaged. Undo with rollback-m4a-ownership-and-roles.sql, which puts
    is_ops_admin() back and re-points all 16 sites to it.

  EXPECTED AFTER-STATE, EXACTLY
    is_ops_admin exists       : no
    policies on is_ops_admin  : 0
    functions on is_ops_admin : 0
    _handover_owner falls back: no
    owner resolves to         : lone@keywellness.co.bw   (unchanged)
    is_psychosocial_admin     : yes
    psychosocial_admins       : 2 rows, Lone and Michelle
    admins                    : the same five, unchanged
    counts                    : the same five, unchanged
